evaluation: BENCHMARK.md §6f — LLM recipe-generation vs the certified benchmark

choices.notes: EVENTS: taken from the BIDS events.tsv `onset` column (seconds), keeping only value==80 (standard) and value==70 (deviant); value==180 (first-stream standards) and the STATUS marker (value==1) are excluded. Onsets are attached as MNE Annotations so timing stays exact in seconds across the resample; verified against the .set file's own annotations (identical counts, max onset difference 5e-5 s). CHANNELS: the three EOG channels (HEOG_left/HEOG_right/VEOG_lower) are typed EEG in the .set file, so they are dropped by name before any referencing; montage standard_1020 with match_case=False. ORDER: bandpass 0.1-30 Hz zero-phase FIR (firwin/hamming) -> resample 1024->256 Hz -> average reference -> RANSAC -> interpolate bads (spherical spline, mode='accurate') -> re-apply average reference (the mean changes once bad channels carry interpolated data) -> epoch. RANSAC: autoreject.Ransac at its defaults (n_resample=50, min_corr=0.75, min_channels=0.25, unbroken_time=0.4, random_state=42), fit on unrejected -0.2..0.5 s epochs. min_channels was checked rather than assumed: an injected-artefact test on two subjects RANSAC called clean (sub-002/sub-005) showed the 0.25 default catches noise/drift corruptions in 12/12 cases with no false positives, whereas min_channels=0.50 missed most of them AND misattributed the artefact to neighbouring channels (flagging CPz/FCz when Cz was corrupted), i.e. a larger consensus subset lowers RANSAC's breakdown point. The same test showed RANSAC is blind to flat and pure-gain channels (its criterion is a scale-invariant correlation), so an explicit flat-channel guard (SD < 1e-9 V) was added; it fired for no subject in this dataset. REJECTION: the recipe's '+-100 uV' is implemented as MNE's peak-to-peak criterion reject=dict(eeg=100e-6) over the full -0.2..0.5 s epoch on scalp EEG. This reading is not load-bearing: re-running with an absolute |amplitude| > 100 uV rule instead gives a grand mean of -0.803 uV vs -0.822 uV, per-subject r = 0.963, and zero exclusions either way. ICA: not used. The task is a passive oddball (participants watched a silent video), the recipe explicitly permits amplitude rejection alone for ERP CORE MMN, and trial retention stayed high, so no ICA/ICLabel stage was run. MEASURE: standard and deviant trial counts are NOT equalized (the recipe does not ask for it). Difference wave = deviant-average minus standard-average; the reported value is the mean of that difference over the 100-250 ms samples and over Fz, FCz, Cz jointly, in uV. OUTCOME: RANSAC flagged >=1 bad channel in 28/40 subjects (union: C3, C4, C5, C6, F7, F8, FC4, FP1, FP2, O1, Oz, P10, P4, P7, P8, PO3, PO4, PO8); median trials retained after rejection 84.6%; every subject cleared the >=50 deviant / >=150 standard rule (worst case 80 deviants, 331 standards), so nothing was excluded. SANITY CHECKS: the grand-average difference wave has a flat pre-stimulus baseline and a negative peak of -1.60 uV at 191 ms at Fz/FCz/Cz, is most negative at Fz, and inverts polarity at the mastoid-adjacent sites (P9 +1.16 uV, P10 +0.96 uV) -- the expected MMN signature for a supratemporal generator under an average reference. Across subjects t(39) = -7.84, p = 1.5e-9, Cohen's d = -1.24.

Order: drop the 3 EOG channels by name (they are typed EEG in the .set) -> standard_1020 montage (match_case=False) -> 0.1-30 Hz zero-phase FIR (firwin/hamming, MNE 'auto' transition bands) -> resample 1024->256 Hz -> average reference over the 30 scalp channels -> autoreject.Ransac bad-channel detection on the -0.2..0.5 s epochs -> spherical-spline interpolation of bads -> average re-reference -> epoch -0.2..0.5 s, baseline (-0.2, 0), reject peak-to-peak > 100 uV. Events read from *_events.tsv 'onset' (seconds) x 'value'; only value==80 (standard) and value==70 (deviant) kept -- value==180 first-stream standards and STATUS markers excluded. Difference wave = deviant-average minus standard-average (mne.combine_evoked weights [1,-1]); measure = mean over Fz/FCz/Cz x 100-250 ms, in uV. No ICA: passive-listening ERP CORE MMN is clean and the recipe permits the simple +-100 uV epoch reject. JUDGMENT CALLS: (a) '+-100 uV' implemented as MNE's peak-to-peak reject=dict(eeg=100e-6) -- the stricter reading; the looser reading (+-100 uV absolute == 200 uV peak-to-peak) gives grand mean -0.7730 uV, so the measure is insensitive to this choice. (b) resample rate 256 Hz = largest integer divisor of 1024 Hz above the 200 Hz floor. (c) RANSAC run after the first average reference, following the recipe's literal 'reference -> RANSAC -> interpolate -> re-reference' ordering (this is algebraically equivalent to referencing after interpolation, since the first reference is common-mode and cancels in the second). autoreject.Ransac defaults were used (n_resample=50, min_channels=0.25, min_corr=0.75, unbroken_time=0.4, random_state=42); on this sparse 30-ch montage it tends to flag peripheral sites (F7, FP1, Oz, O1, C5/C6), median 1 channel per subject, max 6. Disabling RANSAC entirely changes the grand mean only to -0.8399 uV, but drops sub-007 and sub-012 below the min-trial rule (a single noisy channel blows the 100 uV peak-to-peak criterion on most epochs), so RANSAC mainly buys trial retention here. (d) Baseline correction applied at epoching rather than as a separate step. (e) All 40 subjects met the >=50 deviant / >=150 standard rule, so none were excluded. SANITY CHECK: the grand-average difference wave over Fz/FCz/Cz is flat pre-stimulus and peaks negative at ~195 ms (-1.48 uV), the expected MMN morphology; the effect is reliable across subjects (37/40 negative, one-sample t(39) = -7.84, p = 1.5e-09).

Harmonized minimal config, executed exactly as specified. Events read from the BIDS *_events.tsv 'value' column (80=standard, 70=deviant); value==180 (first stream) and the non-stimulus STATUS rows were excluded. Event samples computed as round(onset_sec * 256) after resampling (raw.first_samp==0). Order: drop EOG -> standard_1020 (match_case=False) -> FIR bandpass 0.1-30 Hz (MNE defaults: firwin, zero phase, auto transition bandwidths) -> resample 256 Hz -> average reference over the 30 scalp channels -> epoch -0.2..0.5 s, baseline (-0.2, 0) -> reject peak-to-peak > 100 uV. No ICA, no RANSAC / interpolation, no AutoReject. Rejection is applied by MNE after baseline correction, on the 30 EEG channels only. Measure = mean of (deviant-average minus standard-average) over channels Fz, FCz, Cz and over all samples with 0.100 <= t <= 0.250 s, in microvolts. Subject excluded if <50 deviants or <150 standards survive rejection.
judgment_calls: Window edges: at 256 Hz the sample grid does not land exactly on 100 ms, so the inclusive mask 0.100 <= t <= 0.250 spans t = 0.1016 .. 0.2500 s (39 samples). The nearest sample below (0.0977 s) is excluded. Including it would change each subject's value only marginally (1/39 of the window).
sub-002 has a shorter event stream in its events.tsv (167 deviants / 653 standards instead of 200 / 785); all available trials were used and it still clears the minimums.
Duplicate event sample indices after resampling to 256 Hz were de-duplicated (none actually occurred in this dataset).
The .set file types the EOG channels as EEG, so they were dropped by name before the montage/reference; the average reference therefore uses exactly the 30 scalp channels.

choices.notes: Harmonized minimal MMN config, executed exactly as specified. Events taken from the BIDS *_events.tsv `onset` column (seconds), converted to sample indices at the post-resample rate via round(onset*256); only value==80 (standard) and value==70 (deviant) were kept, value==180 (first-stream) and the STATUS marker (value==1) were dropped. EOG dropped by name (HEOG_left/HEOG_right/VEOG_lower) because the .set types them as EEG. Montage standard_1020 with match_case=False resolves the file's FP1/FP2 naming to Fp1/Fp2. Order followed the recipe literally: filter -> resample -> average reference -> epoch. Filter is MNE's default zero-phase FIR (firwin, hamming, auto-length). Peak-to-peak rejection applied at epoching via reject=dict(eeg=100e-6) on the 30 scalp channels; reject_by_annotation=False so only the p2p criterion drops epochs. Difference wave = deviant - standard per subject (mne.combine_evoked weights [1,-1]); measure is the mean of the difference wave over channels Fz/FCz/Cz and over the 100-250 ms window via Evoked.crop(0.100, 0.250) (MNE-inclusive endpoints), reported in microvolts. Grand mean is the unweighted mean across included subjects. No ICA, no RANSAC/interpolation, no AutoReject.
